audit.why: Both layers already read Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Skill, Zac, which is exactly what the mirror audit (zac__gragas) settled on: Gragas through level 6, Skill at first item, Zac at 2+ items. 57.89% supports it. I did not touch the chart — the packet's 'Skill' at level 1 is the lone dissent and the mirror outranks it.
Spikes cover level 2 (Q+W), level 6 (E-W-Q-R), first item shred, and his level-3 E-into-Q all-in as the counter-threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: Elastic Slingshot is called 'his engage' with no number, and the page never states its 21/18/15/12/9s cooldown — the longest cooldown either champion has, and the entire reason this lane is winnable. wants.you[2] also lumps his W in as a 'long cooldown'; Unstable Matter is 5 seconds. The passive's full behaviour (splits into 4 bloblets on fatal damage and revives if any survive) is never stated either, only the blob healing.
audit.why: 21 seconds at rank 1 is a free window every time he uses E on the wave or to escape; treating his 5s W as punishable cooldown is advice that gets you killed inside 350 range.
audit.corrected: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — commit the moment he spends it. Q grab is 14s at rank 1. Unstable Matter is 5s and hits for percent max HP, so never idle in 350 range. On lethal damage he splits into 4 bloblets and revives if any survive.
